coverage_exempt.reason: Original table growth 0x4db6e0 can return zero only after realloc failure. It stores the null result in EBP and calls 0x4dc680, which reads [EBP+4] and faults at address 4 before returning. Checked against the original helper and both growth branches; this owned fallback therefore cannot execute successfully.

Original repeat out-of-range lookup cannot execute: an initially in-range callback reaches the second bounds check with no intervening call or bound write; a successful first growth updates the bounds to include the index and clears every new table entry, causing the zero-callback branch to bypass this check. Checked against original 0x47f800 and 0x4db6e0.

Original repeated lookup cannot return zero: the repeat out-of-range branch is unreachable without intervening bound changes; furthermore null realloc in 0x4db6e0 puts zero in EBP and faults at [EBP+4] inside 0x4dc680 before any zero return. Checked against both original helpers; this error fallback cannot execute successfully.

limits: SetRect and SetRectEmpty use rectangle-writing fixtures; no USER32 code executes.
InterlockedDecrement uses a scripted reference-count update; no operating-system synchronization executes.
Cases keep locale width at most one and the original flag text ASCII, avoiding the locale conversion imports below 0x4dbe10.
notes: Boundary-reviewed against the corpus: 0x47ff90 is thiscall with one argument and returns its receiver; 0x4805c0 is thiscall with no stack arguments and no meaningful return. Constructor x87 state flows through the original base constructor and __ftol.
